page.layout: One column of running text in the centre. In the right margin, beside the second paragraph, the section number XXIV. Running head above the text, page number at top right. Gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.l: in quâ & mentionem fecit XXIV. libro-
rum ab eo in Evangelium scriptorum, ne-
que tantùm adversus Basilidem, sed &
filium ejus Isidorum scripsit teste Theo-
doreto ; Unde concludit Pearsonius Basi-
lidem qui sub Hadriano tot libros edide-
rat, filiúmque ac discipulum notum etiam
scriptorem tunc habuit, sub Trajano sua
docuisse par esse credere : mera conjectu-
ra nulla solidâ ratione fulta. Agrippa Ca-
stor sub fine imperij Hadriani Basilidem
confutavit ; potuit ergo tot libros antea
scribere, & forte etiam antequam haere-
sim suam spargere coepisset ; Isidorus ve-
rò filius ejus eodem tempore figmenta
sua disseminabat, & eapropter ab eodem
Agrippa refutatus fuit ; Recentiorum te-
stimonia, Ioelis videlicet Chronographi,
& Albufaraij non moror, quoniam de re-
bus adeò antiquis sine vetustiorum aucto-
ritate loquuntur, immò ijs plane contra-
ria docent.
Explosâ igitur falsâ Eruditissimi Vindi-
ciarum Auctoris Chronologiâ, exami-
nandae superfunt, quas opponit ad Vete-
rum à Dallaeo allata testimonia excep-
tiones: Inchoat à Clemente Alexandri-
no, cujus locum mirè corruptum arbitra-
tur pag. 84. 85. Verùm de totâ pericope
non agitur, nollem enim diffiteri [?] quin

page.notes: The word "sed" in "sed &" has a strike-through line across it, as printed in the copy. The line "diffiteri quin" is cut off at the scan edge; "diffiteri" is a best reading. The signature "L l" may read "L 1". The margin number XXIV. sits beside the paragraph "Explosâ igitur" and is placed at the point where that paragraph begins. The copy has a Google digitiser stamp at the bottom right, which is left out.
